environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but pod annotation specifies a custom OCI runtime hook that loads a BPF-based syscall filter at container init. The filter JSON (mounted from ConfigMap 'syscall-policy-strict-v3') defines an allowlist via libseccomp architecture-aware rules compiled for SCMP_ARCH_X86_64. The policy denies with SCMP_ACT_KILL_PROCESS on: __NR_execve (59), __NR_execveat (322), __NR_ptrace (101), __NR_socket (41), __NR_connect (42), __NR_clone3 (435) with CLONE_NEWUSER flag. The filter is applied via prctl(PR_SET_SECCOMP, SECCOMP_MODE_FILTER) before the Go runtime starts (injected by the OCI hook). Note: the Go runtime's internal use of clone(2) for goroutines uses clone(not clone3) with standard flags and is allowlisted. The net/http listener socket is pre-opened by the hook and passed as fd 3 via LISTEN_FDS=1 socket activation, so the running process never needs to call socket() itself.

config.socket_activation: LISTEN_FDS=1, pre-opened TCP socket on fd 3
